nl.perturbation: a=z+0.2*xi in x only, xi independent standard Normal; identical probe array reused across candidates and paths
nl.required_paths: truth and at least 5 of 9 prior paths
nl.selection: first candidate meeting unchanged bar; no seed or threshold selection from results
nl.target: exact Euler-Maruyama nonlinear polynomial mean; public simulations use native Diffrax as documented
nl.finite_checks: all saved trajectories and exact one-step means at paths and probes finite; report native checks and transition Jacobian distributions

obs.y_keep: indices divisible by 32, including both endpoints

prior.grid_construction: recorded readings retain original timestamps; exact known-input readings also at each 337.5-second midpoint; measurement_clock stays 675s because Duration only accepts integer seconds

mode.x_readings: none; latent x is interior to u -> x -> y
mode.event: at least one completed opposite-neighborhood visit in days [0.5,2], after a well has been established
mode.posterior_requirement: full-target evidence of separated mass, not symmetry alone; if unavailable cheaply, mark untested and do not write scorecard request

cpu_refusal_checks: only C7/C8 local zero-warmup zero-draw fit requests, to exercise native preflight; no retained inference
